A magic barrier is blocking the entrance of\nthe Cradle of Soldiers. Burnos said that the\ncharm was needed but...
How can we get into...
Wh-Whoa, whoaaaa?!
Ugh!
The magic barrier was removed by the charm.\nNow you can enter the Cradle of Soldiers!
Ouchch...\nAdventurer, now we can get in!
Noooo!!
You entered here with the charm, so you must be\nreinforcements... But, a human... I kinda feel\nhelpless... Anyway, hurry.
Dunkelis is being cornered at the back of the\nCradle... Please, save her...
Dunkelis! Are you alright?!
?! No! Run right now!!
Go to the Dark Manor with me.\nIt's no use your resisting.
As I've told you many times, I won't do that.\nI never act as you wish.
We already know that the Dark Manor connects with\nthe shrine of the 12 gods.
And it's only you who can open the gate.\nMore than half of your troops are in our hand.
The rest is to take you to the manor and send\nour troops to the shrine via the gate to defeat\nthe 12 gods. Come with us now.
Who dares to go with you after hearing that?!
Hmm... We just need your ability to open the gate.\nIf you dare to continue the resistance, we'll take\nyou after tearing you limb from limb!
Dunkelis! Over here!!
Another resistance, huh.
No!!
Whoa! At a time like this?!
Who are you?!
Whoa?! Y-You're...
the legendary adventurer who saved the world from\ncrisis many times?!
What are you... You're not a god, nor a human.\nYou don't even have a body...\nA spiritual existence?!
That's impossible.\nHow absurd... What's going on in this world...
Ignore the absurdity.\nMake the invasion to the shrine of the gods\ntop priority.
I've warned many times.\nIt's no use resisting.
You came to help us.\nThank you, the Savior of the World!
He is the legendary savior who has solved a lot\nof crises that occurred in the world long time\nago...
But you've become a high-class soul and ascended\nto Noieverre the world of high dimension...\nWhy are you here?
!! You sensed the emergency in the Dark Domain\nand came to save us from Noieverre?!\nI really can't say thank you enough...
The Dark Manor is already in our hands.\nYou'll never see other gods...
The manor has fallen to you?! No way!\nVatendeth left for the Dark Manor...
?! If you say it's true, what happened to him?!\nAnswer me!!
Ha ha... Ha ha ha...
We've gotta see what's happening at the Dark\nManor and if Vatendeth is safe...
The legendary adventurer is right, Dunkelis.
If you went to the Dark Manor now, your ability\nmight be abused by them.
The new adventurer!\nYou'll go for us?!
I understood. I know it's not easy but please\nrelease the Dark Manor from them and...
Please save Vatendeth if you find he's captured.\nI'm counting on you.
Looks like he's saying, leave this place and\nDunkelis to me.
I'll stay and protect here to stop the soldiers\nand knights haunted by the black crystals from\nincreasing with the soul of the adventurer.
It's regretful that I can't assist you.\nThank you in advance.
Oh, adventurer! The bridge between the trace of\nthe Dark River and the manor is broken, right?!
No worries. I'll do something so you can walk\nacross there. It will be ready by the time you\nreach the trace of the river.
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing! Go to Trace of Dark River.
